about: Narration for Held. The supers carry the claims; the voice says the why, in the gaps between them. It never speaks over the two silences or the button press.

lines.text: Leave it open, and the rain falls.
Turn it up. The night comes back.
Water turns to silk. Stars stay still.
Most cameras stop time. This one holds it.
Halden, LF-1. See in the dark.
